**DR04** is a medical diagnosis code used in the Danish healthcare system to classify bleeding from the respiratory tract (airways) [^src1]. Within the context of the Danish Atrial Fibrillation Database (AFDK), it serves as a critical data point for monitoring patient safety and tracking treatment complications across the national cardiovascular quality development program [^src2].

Specifically, DR04 is utilized in the clinical quality indicator that measures the incidence of severe bleeding ([[alvorlig-bloedning|Alvorlig blødning]]) among patients diagnosed with atrial fibrillation ([[atrieflimren|atrieflimren]]) [^src3]. To ensure comprehensive surveillance of adverse bleeding events, the AFDK methodology employs a broad spectrum of ICD-10-DK diagnosis codes. DR04 is grouped alongside codes such as [[dj942|DJ942]], [[dn02|DN02]], and [[dr31|DR31]] to specifically capture instances of urinary tract and lung/respiratory bleeding [^src1]. This standardized coding framework allows for consistent data collection, rigorous epidemiological tracking, and regional comparison of healthcare quality for atrial fibrillation patients in Denmark [^src2].
